blocks.text: Ikki zamon yonma-yon: chegaralangan va chegarasiz

Present Continuous (→ 1-dars) va Present Simple (→ 2-dars) ni alohida ko'rdik, asosiy farqi qizil kitobda ham o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 8-dars). Endi ularni chuqurroq solishtiramiz. Asosiy savol: harakat **chegaralangan** davr ichida bo'lyaptimi (hozir, shu hafta, vaqtincha) yoki **chegarasiz** — umuman, doim, takror-takror? Birinchisi — **am / is / are + -ing**, ikkinchisi — **V / V-s**. O'zbekchada ham xuddi shu farq bor: «ishla**yapti**» va «ishla**ydi**».

rows: Hozir yoki shu atrofda: The kettle **is boiling**.
Umuman, har doim: Water **boils** at 100 degrees.
Vaqtinchalik: I**'m staying** at a hotel this week.

blocks.text: Bir xil fe'l ikki zamonda ikki xil savolga javob beradi. Continuous — «**hozir nima bo'lyapti?**», Simple — «**umuman qanday?**». Aziz **is cooking** — u hozir oshxonada. Aziz **cooks** well — bu uning mahorati haqida, hozir u uxlayotgan bo'lishi ham mumkin. Shuning uchun bitta gapda ikkala zamon tez-tez yonma-yon keladi: biri umumiy fon, ikkinchisi — ayni paytdagi manzara.

items.text: Aziz **is cooking** dinner, so he can't come to the phone.
items.translation: Aziz kechki ovqat **tayyorlayapti**, telefonga chiqa olmaydi.

items.text: Aziz **cooks** really well — his plov is famous in our street.
items.translation: Aziz juda yaxshi ovqat **pishiradi** — uning palovi ko'chamizda mashhur.

items.text: It **snows** a lot in Chimgan in January, and it**'s snowing** there right now.
items.translation: Yanvarda Chimyonda ko'p qor **yog'adi**, hozir ham u yerda qor **yog'yapti**.

blocks.text: Ko'pincha tanlov faktga emas, **gapiruvchining qarashiga** bog'liq. Oksfordda uch yildan beri ishlayotgan odam «I **work** in Oxford» deydi — bu uning doimiy ish joyi. Agar u u yerda faqat loyiha tugaguncha bo'lsa, «I**'m working** in Oxford» deydi. **until**, **for now**, **for a few weeks**, **while ...** kabi so'zlar vaqtinchalikni ko'rsatadi va Continuous ni talab qiladi.

items.text: James **works** for a bank in London.
This month James **is working** at the bank's office in Tashkent.
items.translation: Bu oy Jeyms bankning Toshkentdagi ofisida **ishlayapti**.

items.text: **I'm using** my sister's laptop until mine is repaired.

blocks.text: **always** odatda Present Simple bilan keladi: I **always take** the metro — bu oddiy odat, his-tuyg'usiz xabar. Lekin **always** (shuningdek **constantly**, **forever**, **continually**) Present Continuous bilan kelsa, ma'no o'zgaradi: harakat **haddan tashqari ko'p**, kutilmagan yoki asabga tegadigan darajada takrorlanadi. He**'s always losing** his keys! — U **nuqul** kalitini **yo'qotadi**! Bu gapda shikoyat, jahl yoki hayrat bor. O'zbekchada bu ma'noga «**nuqul ...**», «**doim ... -ib yuradi**», «**-gani -gan**» to'g'ri keladi.

rows: You**'re always taking** my charger! (jahl: «nuqul olasan»)
Tom **always calls** his mum on Sundays.
Tom**'s always calling** me late at night. (asabga tegadi)
Granny **always helps** us with the children.

blocks.text: Diqqat: always + Continuous har doim ham salbiy emas. Ba'zan bu hayrat yoki maqtov: She**'s always smiling** — U doim jilmayib yuradi. Muhimi — gapiruvchi bu takrorni **ko'zga tashlanadigan, g'ayrioddiy** deb biladi va unga o'z munosabatini bildiradi. **always** bu gapda **be** va **-ing** orasida turadi: She **is always complaining**.

items.text: I **always forget** people's names, so I write them down.
items.translation: Odamlarning ismini **doim unutaman**, shuning uchun yozib qo'yaman.

items.text: She**'s always smiling** — I've never seen her in a bad mood.
items.translation: U **doim jilmayib yuradi** — uni hech qachon yomon kayfiyatda ko'rmaganman.

blocks.text: **What do you do?** — «Nima ish qilasiz? Kasbingiz nima?», **What are you doing?** — «Hozir (yoki shu kunlarda) nima qilyapsiz?». Xuddi shunday: **How do you get** to work? — odatda qanday borasiz; **How are you getting** to work? — hozir, masalan, mashinangiz ta'mirda ekan, qanday borayapsiz. Savolni noto'g'ri zamonda bersangiz, suhbatdosh boshqa savolga javob beradi.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Every day I'm going to work by metro.» → Every day I **go** ... (har kungi odat — Simple); «He always is late.» → He **is always** late.; «I'm always go there.» → I **always go** there. (oddiy odat) yoki I**'m always going** there! (nuqul boraman); kasb haqida «What are you doing?» → **What do you do?**; «I am living here since 2015.» → I**'ve lived** here since 2015 (→ 11-dars).
always + Continuous ni o'zbekcha «**nuqul**» so'zi bilan tekshiring: «nuqul» mos tushsa (Nuqul kechikadi!) — Continuous; oddiy «har doim» bo'lsa (Har doim soat yettida turaman) — Simple.

Holat fe'llari (know, want, belong) va think / have / see ning ikki ma'nosi → 4-dars. O'tgan zamonda xuddi shunday juftlik — I was doing / I did → 6-dars. Kelajak rejasi uchun Present Continuous (I**'m meeting** Tom tomorrow) → 19-dars.

rows: nuqul, haddan ziyod: You**'re always interrupting**!
oddiy odat: I **always walk** to work.

examples.title: Now or in general? **is playing** / **plays**
examples.description: Bir xil fe'l: hozir bo'layotgan harakat — Continuous, umuman, takroriy — Simple. Ko'p gaplarda ikkalasi yonma-yon.

sentences.text: Kate **plays** the violin, but right now she**'s playing** the piano just for fun.
sentences.translation: Keyt skripka **chaladi**, lekin hozir shunchaki ermak uchun pianino **chalyapti**.

sentences.text: Listen — the neighbours' dog **is barking** again. It **barks** at every passing car.
sentences.translation: Quloq sol — qo'shnining iti yana **huryapti**. U har bir o'tgan mashinaga **huradi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod usually **speaks** very quietly, so why **is** he **shouting** now?
sentences.translation: Bekzod odatda juda past ovozda **gapiradi**, nega u hozir **baqiryapti**?

sentences.text: My father **reads** two newspapers a day, and at the moment he**'s reading** the sports page.
sentences.translation: Otam kuniga ikkita gazeta **o'qiydi**, hozir esa sport sahifasini **o'qiyapti**.

sentences.text: What **are** the children **doing** in the garden? — They**'re picking** apples.
sentences.translation: Bolalar bog'da nima **qilishyapti**? — Olma **terishyapti**.

sentences.text: Our cat **sleeps** about sixteen hours a day, and of course it**'s sleeping** now.
sentences.translation: Mushugimiz kuniga o'n olti soatcha **uxlaydi**, hozir ham, albatta, **uxlayapti**.

sentences.text: Jasur **is talking** on the phone, so he can't hear the doorbell.
sentences.translation: Jasur telefonda **gaplashyapti**, shuning uchun eshik qo'ng'irog'ini eshitmayapti.

sentences.text: Emma **speaks** four languages, and right now she**'s translating** a contract into French.
sentences.translation: Emma to'rt tilda **gapiradi**, hozir esa shartnomani fransuz tiliga **tarjima qilyapti**.

sentences.text: **Is** it **raining** in London? — Of course, it usually **rains** there in November.
sentences.translation: Londonda yomg'ir **yog'yaptimi**? — Albatta, u yerda noyabrda odatda yomg'ir **yog'adi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza rarely **complains**, so if she **is complaining** now, something is really wrong.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza kamdan-kam **noliydi**, agar hozir **nolayotgan** bo'lsa, demak, nimadir jiddiy noto'g'ri.

examples.title: Temporary or permanent? **is staying** / **lives**
examples.description: Doimiy holat — Simple, vaqtinchalik — Continuous. Tanlov ko'pincha gapiruvchining holatni qanday ko'rishiga bog'liq.

sentences.text: Madina **lives** in Bukhara, but this term she**'s studying** in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Madina Buxoroda **yashaydi**, lekin bu semestr Toshkentda **o'qiyapti**.

sentences.text: Oliver **is staying** at a hotel near the station until his flat is ready.
sentences.translation: Oliver kvartirasi tayyor bo'lgunicha vokzal yaqinidagi mehmonxonada **turibdi**.

sentences.text: **I'm sleeping** on the sofa this week because my parents **are visiting** us.
sentences.translation: Bu hafta divanda **uxlayapman**, chunki ota-onam bizda **mehmon bo'lib turishibdi**.

sentences.text: The bank **employs** two hundred people, but it**'s taking on** extra staff for the summer.
sentences.translation: Bankda ikki yuz kishi **ishlaydi**, lekin yoz uchun qo'shimcha xodimlar **olyapti**.

sentences.text: My brother **works** in Samarkand, but he**'s working** from home while his leg heals.
sentences.translation: Akam Samarqandda **ishlaydi**, lekin oyog'i tuzalguncha uydan **ishlayapti**.

sentences.text: Normally Sarah **cycles** to the office, but she**'s taking** the bus until her bike is fixed.
sentences.translation: Odatda Sara ofisga velosipedda **boradi**, lekin velosipedi tuzatilguncha avtobusda **qatnayapti**.

sentences.text: Where **do** you **live**? — In Oxford, but **I'm renting** a room in London for a few months.
sentences.translation: Qayerda **yashaysiz**? — Oksfordda, lekin bir necha oyga Londonda xona **ijaraga olib turibman**.

sentences.text: These days Aziz **is getting up** at five because he**'s preparing** for a marathon.
sentences.translation: Aziz shu kunlarda soat beshda **turyapti**, chunki marafonga **tayyorlanyapti**.

sentences.text: James **is** a vegetarian, but he**'s eating** fish on this trip because there's little else.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **vegetarian**, lekin bu safarda baliq **yeyapti**, chunki boshqa ovqat deyarli yo'q.

sentences.text: **Are** you **working** in the city centre now, or **do** you still **work** near the airport?
sentences.translation: Hozir shahar markazida **ishlayapsizmi** yoki hali ham aeroport yaqinida **ishlaysizmi**?

examples.title: What **do** you **do**? / What **are** you **doing**?
examples.description: Savollarda ham farq saqlanadi: What do you do? — kasb, odat; What are you doing? — hozirgi harakat yoki shu kunlardagi ish.

sentences.text: What **do** you **do**? — I'm a nurse at the children's hospital.
sentences.translation: Nima **ish qilasiz**? — Bolalar shifoxonasida hamshiraman.

sentences.text: What **are** you **doing** under the table? — I**'m looking** for my earring.
sentences.translation: Stol tagida nima **qilyapsan**? — Sirg'amni **qidiryapman**.

sentences.text: How **do** you usually **get** to work? — By metro, because it's quicker.
sentences.translation: Ishga odatda qanday **borasiz**? — Metroda, chunki tezroq.

sentences.text: How **are** you **getting** to work while the metro line is closed?
sentences.translation: Metro liniyasi yopiq ekan, ishga qanday **qatnayapsiz**?

sentences.text: **Does** Bekzod **play** football? — Yes, he's in the university team.
sentences.translation: Bekzod futbol **o'ynaydimi**? — Ha, u universitet jamoasida.

sentences.text: **Is** he **playing** in today's match, or is his knee still bad?
sentences.translation: U bugungi o'yinda **o'ynayaptimi** yoki tizzasi hali ham og'riyaptimi?

sentences.text: Where **do** you **buy** your vegetables? — At the Chorsu bazaar, usually.
sentences.translation: Sabzavotlarni qayerdan **olasiz**? — Odatda Chorsu bozoridan.

sentences.text: Why **are** you **wearing** a suit today? **Do** you **have** a job interview?
sentences.translation: Nega bugun kostyum **kiyib olgansiz**? Ish bo'yicha suhbatingiz **bormi**?

sentences.text: Who **are** you **texting** at this time of night? — Just my sister in London.
sentences.translation: Tunning bu mahalida kimga **xabar yozyapsan**? — Londondagi opamga, xolos.

sentences.text: Which newspaper **do** you **read** when you **want** serious news?
sentences.translation: Jiddiy yangilik **kerak bo'lsa**, qaysi gazetani **o'qiysiz**?

examples.title: **always** + continuous: annoying habits
examples.description: always / constantly / forever + Continuous — haddan tashqari ko'p takrorlanadigan, asabga tegadigan odat. O'zbekchada «nuqul ...», «doim ... -ib yuradi».

sentences.text: My flatmate **is always leaving** dirty cups in the sink.
sentences.translation: Xonadoshim iflos piyolalarni **nuqul** rakovinada **qoldirib ketadi**.

sentences.text: You**'re always interrupting** me when I'm trying to explain something!
sentences.translation: Biror narsani tushuntirmoqchi bo'lsam, **nuqul gapimni bo'lasan**!

sentences.text: Oliver **is constantly checking** his phone, even during meetings.
sentences.translation: Oliver hatto yig'ilishlarda ham **tinmay telefonini tekshirib turadi**.

sentences.text: Our neighbours **are forever arguing** about money, and we can hear every word.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz pul ustida **janjallashgani janjallashgan**, har bir so'zi eshitilib turadi.

sentences.text: Why **are** you **always borrowing** my charger without asking?
sentences.translation: Nega so'ramasdan zaryadlovchimni **nuqul olib ketasan**?

sentences.text: That printer **is always breaking down** just before an important deadline.
sentences.translation: O'sha printer muhim topshiriq muddatidan oldin **doim buzilib qoladi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **is always promising** to fix the tap, but he never does.
sentences.translation: Jasur jo'mrakni tuzatishga **nuqul va'da beradi-yu**, hech qachon tuzatmaydi.

sentences.text: Grandad **is always complaining** that young people don't respect the elderly.
sentences.translation: Bobom yoshlar keksalarni hurmat qilmaydi, deb **doim nolib yuradi**.

sentences.text: She**'s forever losing** her glasses — yesterday they were on her head!
sentences.translation: U ko'zoynagini **nuqul yo'qotib qo'yadi** — kecha boshida ekan!

sentences.text: The manager **is constantly changing** the schedule, so nobody can plan anything.
sentences.translation: Menejer jadvalni **tinmay o'zgartirib turadi**, shuning uchun hech kim hech narsani rejalashtira olmaydi.

examples.title: Surprise and praise: **always smiling**, **always helping**
examples.description: always + Continuous har doim shikoyat emas: gapiruvchi uchun ko'zga tashlanadigan takror — hayrat yoki maqtov ham bo'lishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Nilufar **is always smiling**, even on difficult days at work.
sentences.translation: Nilufar ishdagi og'ir kunlarda ham **doim jilmayib yuradi**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **is always cooking** something delicious for the neighbours.
sentences.translation: Buvim qo'shnilar uchun **doim** nimadir mazali **pishirib turadi**.

sentences.text: Tom **is always reading** — he takes a book everywhere he goes.
sentences.translation: Tom **doim kitob o'qib yuradi** — qayerga borsa, o'zi bilan kitob oladi.

sentences.text: Our teacher **is always finding** new ways to make grammar interesting.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz grammatikani qiziqarli qilishning **doim** yangi yo'llarini **topib turadi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **is always offering** to help, which is why everyone likes him.
sentences.translation: Aziz **doim yordam taklif qilib turadi**, shuning uchun hamma uni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: Kate**'s always travelling** somewhere — last month it was Japan, now it's Peru.
sentences.translation: Keyt **doim** qayergadir **sayohat qilib yuradi** — o'tgan oy Yaponiya edi, endi Peru.

sentences.text: My little son **is always asking** questions about space, and I can't answer half of them.
sentences.translation: Kichkina o'g'lim **doim** koinot haqida **savol berib turadi**, ularning yarmiga javob berolmayman.

sentences.text: Emma **is constantly learning** something new: pottery, Spanish, coding.
sentences.translation: Emma **tinmay** yangi narsa **o'rganib turadi**: kulolchilik, ispan tili, dasturlash.

sentences.text: James **is always bringing** cakes and sweets to the office, and we love him for it.
sentences.translation: Jeyms ofisga **doim** tort va shirinlik **olib keladi**, buning uchun uni yaxshi ko'ramiz.

sentences.text: Volunteers like Dilnoza **are always looking** for ways to help lonely old people.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaga o'xshagan ko'ngillilar yolg'iz keksalarga yordam berish yo'llarini **doim qidirib yurishadi**.

examples.title: **always takes** or **is always taking**?
examples.description: Juftliklar: always + Simple — oddiy odat (betaraf xabar), always + Continuous — haddan ziyod takror va gapiruvchining munosabati.

sentences.text: I **always take** the stairs, but my colleague **is always taking** the lift to the first floor!
sentences.translation: Men **doim** zinadan **chiqaman**, hamkasbim esa ikkinchi qavatga ham **nuqul** liftda **chiqadi**!

sentences.text: Madina **always calls** her mother on Sunday evenings.
sentences.translation: Madina yakshanba oqshomlari **doim** onasiga **qo'ng'iroq qiladi**.

sentences.text: Madina's brother **is always calling** her at midnight to ask for money.
sentences.translation: Madinaning ukasi esa yarim tunda unga pul so'rab **nuqul qo'ng'iroq qiladi**.

sentences.text: Our bus **always leaves** at 7.15, so I set two alarms.
sentences.translation: Avtobusimiz **doim** soat 7:15 da **jo'naydi**, shuning uchun ikkita budilnik qo'yaman.

sentences.text: This bus **is always leaving** early — I've missed it three times this week!
sentences.translation: Bu avtobus **nuqul** vaqtidan oldin **jo'nab ketadi** — shu hafta uch marta qolib ketdim!

sentences.text: **Does** Tom always **wear** a tie at work? — Yes, it's a company rule.
sentences.translation: Tom ishda **doim** galstuk **taqadimi**? — Ha, bu kompaniya qoidasi.

sentences.text: Tom **is always wearing** that awful green tie, and nobody knows why.
sentences.translation: Tom o'sha xunuk yashil galstukni **nuqul taqib yuradi**, nega — hech kim bilmaydi.

sentences.text: You **always tell** the truth, and that's what I like about you.
sentences.translation: Sen **doim** rostini **aytasan**, menga sening shu jihating yoqadi.

sentences.text: You**'re always telling** me what to do — I'm not a child any more!
sentences.translation: Menga nima qilishni **nuqul aytib turasan** — men endi bola emasman!

sentences.text: The kids **always do** their homework after dinner, but they**'re always arguing** about who starts first.
sentences.translation: Bolalar uy vazifasini **doim** kechki ovqatdan keyin **qilishadi**, lekin kim birinchi boshlashi haqida **nuqul tortishib qolishadi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: complaining about a flatmate
examples.description: Ikki do'st suhbati: xonadoshning odatlari (Simple), hozirgi va vaqtinchalik holat (Continuous) va asabga tegadigan takror (always + Continuous).

sentences.text: — You look annoyed, Sarah. What**'s happening**?
sentences.translation: — Jahling chiqqanga o'xshaydi, Sara. Nima **bo'lyapti**?

sentences.text: — It's my new flatmate. She**'s always playing** loud music after midnight.
sentences.translation: — Yangi xonadoshim. U yarim tundan keyin baland ovozda **nuqul musiqa qo'yadi**.

sentences.text: — Really? What **does** she **do**? Is she a student?
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? U nima **ish qiladi**? Talabami?

sentences.text: — Yes, she **studies** music, so I suppose she **practises** a lot.
sentences.translation: — Ha, musiqa **o'qiydi**, shuning uchun ko'p **mashq qiladi**, shekilli.

sentences.text: — And **is** she **practising** right now, while we're talking?
sentences.translation: — Hozir, biz gaplashayotgan paytda ham **mashq qilyaptimi**?

sentences.text: — No, today she**'s visiting** her parents, thank goodness!
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, bugun ota-onasinikida **mehmonda**, xayriyat!

sentences.text: — **Does** she **help** with the cleaning at least?
sentences.translation: — Hech bo'lmasa, tozalashga **yordam beradimi**?

sentences.text: — Never! And she**'s constantly eating** my food from the fridge.
sentences.translation: — Hech qachon! Ustiga-ustak, muzlatkichdagi ovqatimni **tinmay yeb qo'yadi**.

sentences.text: — You **need** to talk to her. People **don't change** unless you tell them.
sentences.translation: — U bilan gaplashishing **kerak**. Aytmaguningcha odamlar **o'zgarmaydi**.

sentences.text: — I know. **I'm planning** to speak to her this evening, when she **gets** back.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman. Bugun kechqurun u qaytib **kelganda** gaplashishni **rejalashtiryapman**.

examples.title: Mixed: routines, changes and complaints
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: hozirgi jarayon va umumiy holat, vaqtinchalik va doimiy, always + Continuous — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: The company usually **sends** staff to Manchester for training, but this year it**'s running** the courses online.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya odatda xodimlarni o'qish uchun Manchesterga **yuboradi**, lekin bu yil kurslarni onlayn **o'tkazyapti**.

sentences.text: Prices **go up** every spring, yet this year they**'re rising** faster than ever.
sentences.translation: Narxlar har bahorda **ko'tariladi**, lekin bu yil har qachongidan tez **oshib boryapti**.

sentences.text: While the lift is out of order, everyone **is using** the stairs, which **takes** ages.
sentences.translation: Lift ishlamayotgan ekan, hamma zinadan **foydalanyapti**, bu esa bir dunyo vaqt **oladi**.

sentences.text: My phone **is always running out** of battery, so I **carry** a power bank everywhere.
sentences.translation: Telefonimning quvvati **nuqul tugab qoladi**, shuning uchun hamma joyga powerbank **olib yuraman**.

sentences.text: Aziz normally **plays** chess online, but right now he**'s playing** a real grandmaster at the club.
sentences.translation: Aziz odatda onlayn shaxmat **o'ynaydi**, lekin hozir klubda haqiqiy grossmeyster bilan **o'ynayapti**.

sentences.text: Why **are** you **whispering**? Nobody **sleeps** in this part of the house.
sentences.translation: Nega **shivirlayapsan**? Uyning bu qismida hech kim **uxlamaydi**.

sentences.text: Kate **teaches** history, but at the moment she**'s writing** a book about Victorian London.
sentences.translation: Keyt tarixdan **dars beradi**, lekin hozir Viktoriya davridagi London haqida kitob **yozyapti**.

sentences.text: Our cousins from Fergana **are staying** with us, so the house **feels** very crowded.
sentences.translation: Farg'onalik qarindoshlarimiz bizda **turishibdi**, shuning uchun uy juda tiqilinch **tuyuladi**.

sentences.text: Most people **pay** by card nowadays, and more and more shops **are refusing** cash.
sentences.translation: Hozir ko'pchilik karta bilan **to'laydi**, tobora ko'proq do'konlar esa naqd pulni **qabul qilmayapti**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **is constantly apologising** for things that **aren't** her fault.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza o'zining aybi **bo'lmagan** narsalar uchun ham **tinmay uzr so'raydi**.
